channel.description: Latest articles from Isle of Wight Radio (iwradio.co.uk)

item.title: Five Brilliant Brain Teasers For The Week: Christmas Edition
item.description: Pop the kettle on, grab a mince pie, and see how many of these you can crack before peeking at the answers! 1) The Late Santa (Easy) On Christmas Eve, Santa visits a house at 11:55 p.m. He stays inside for 10 minutes, delivering presents and eating a mince pie. When Santa leaves, it’s still Christmas Eve. How is this possible? 2) The Christmas Choir (Easy) A Christmas choir sings for five nights in a row. Each night, more people hear them sing than the night before. Yet, fewer people...

item.title: Isle Of Wight Round Table Sleigh Runs Raise More Than £5,000 For Island Charities
item.description: The Isle of Wight Round Table’s annual Sleigh Runs, supported by WightFibre, have raised £5,134 for two Island charities.

item.title: Former Cowes Chip Shop Could Become One-Bedroom Flat
item.description: A former fish and chip shop in Cowes could be converted into a one-bedroom apartment under new plans submitted to the Isle of Wight Council.

item.title: NHS Warns £48,000 Needed To Make New Isle Of Wight Housing Plan ‘Acceptable’
item.description: The NHS says a £48,158 contribution must be secured before a proposed housing development in Newport can be considered acceptable.

item.title: Island Cricket Clubs And Charities Share Funding Boost From Isle Of Wight Foundation
item.description: Three Isle of Wight cricket clubs have received a funding boost in the latest round of grants from Island Roads’ Isle of Wight Foundation.

item.title: Concerns Raised Over Plans For New Children’s Home Near Newport
item.description: Plans for a new children’s home on the outskirts of Newport have been criticised by nearby residents.

item.title: Donna Jones Calls For Rethink On Delayed Hampshire Mayoral Vote
item.description: A candidate in the running to be Hampshire’s first mayor has launched a petition calling for government to go back on its decision to delay polling day.

item.title: Support And Objections Lodged Over Proposed McDonald’s Drive-Thru In Cowes
item.description: A proposed McDonald’s drive-thru restaurant in Cowes has prompted a wave of public response, with dozens of letters submitted to the Isle of Wight Council.

item.title: Concern Grows For Missing Man Last Seen In Newport
item.description: Police are appealing for help to trace a 68-year-old man who has gone missing from Newport.

item.title: NHS Boss Gives Update On "Shocking" Recent Spate Of Pharmacy Break-Ins
item.description: A “shocking” recent spate of Isle of Wight pharmacy burglaries created “great concern” for contractors and the public, an NHS boss has told councillors.
